interpretation.name: TightenVariantFastenersWithSharedNutrunner
interpretation.goal: Provide the shared nutrunner NR7 to line 4 and tighten that line's variant fasteners. No Recipe is proposed because line 4 does not exist in the current plant state, so its station and variant cannot be determined.
constraints: Line 4 is not defined in the runtime plant state (only lines 1, 2 and 3 exist), so its station and variant are unresolved. The operator must confirm the line or have line 4 registered before a Recipe can be proposed.
Tool NR7 must be reserved before use and released afterwards (E1, E6).
transport-tool Steps must be delegated to agvexecutor (E2).
NR7 is currently at the crib and must be transported to the station before configure-tool and tighten-fasteners (E3).
The tightening program must be obtained via get-program for the variant, with no literal torque or tolerance values (E4).
Every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded (E5).
The tool lease (120 s) must exceed the duration of every single tool-using Step (E9).

findings.message: all requested capabilities are grounded in sigma_i
